title: Intergovernmental Relations in Canada
description: Examines relations between federal, provincial/territorial, municipal and Indigenous governments in Canada across a range of complex policy areas. Topics include managing intergovernmental disputes, the role of fiscal transfers and the changing nature of our federation. Individual and/or team projects explore the state of our social, economic and environmental union.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 547, ADMN 462, ADMN 470 (if taken in the same topic), POLI 490 (if taken in the same topic) and formerly POLI 462.
A combined undergraduate and graduate course.
